title: Phenomena seen everywhere near sensitive places

tellings.quote: you know, Eric, you don't need to rely on the government. You can just go up and look for yourself. The keep idea being that you just need to get adjacent to sensitive places and you'll see these things everywhere.

plain: Strange objects are said to show up everywhere near sensitive places, so anyone who gets close to such sites can see them without help from the government. The mathematician Eric Weinstein repeats what someone told him: "Eric, you don't need to rely on the government. You can just go up and look for yourself," because "you just need to get adjacent to sensitive places and you'll see these things everywhere."
